instruction: Design a system that combines the two given modules, a module that captures the moment when each bit in a 32-bit vector changes from 1 to 0 and a module that detects both rising and falling edges of an 8-bit input signal, to create a new module. The new module should have an additional functional module that takes in both of the output signals from the given modules and performs an OR operation to generate a final output. The output should remain high until a synchronous reset signal is received.
label: trojan
